landing.heroTitle1: Run your coaching in one place.
landing.heroSubtitle: Scheduling, communication, attendance, and discovery for sports coaching.
landing.featuresTitle: Built for the full coaching journey
landing.featuresSubtitle: Less admin. More clarity. More visibility.
landing.feature1Desc: Scheduling, attendance, cancellations, and passes in one app.
landing.feature2Desc: Coaches, schools, and athletes stay up to date on what is happening and who is coming.
landing.feature3Desc: Public profiles help new athletes find the right coach and book with confidence.
landing.stepsTitle: Start with the athletes you already coach
landing.stepsSubtitle: Set up your sessions, invite athletes, and run everything from one system.
landing.step1Desc: Add your sport, locations, schedule, and sessions.
landing.step2Desc: Share a link or code. They join in seconds.
landing.step3Desc: Sessions, updates, attendance, and new inquiries stay in one app.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Start free and bring your coaching, school, and athletes into one system.
